angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 470,293 km at 100.22 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 9.9777 +/- 0.0169 mas (same row, RUWE 1.43): 100.22 pc, no zero-point correction; the RUWE is high, so the astrometry fits a single star poorly, and the parallax is used as published
radiusSource: Radius 0.676 +/- 0.008 solar radii from Livingston et al. 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-174 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..102L/abstract): 470,293 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.7 +/- 0.025 solar masses from Livingston et al. 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-174 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..102L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4455 +/- 31 K from Livingston et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-174 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..102L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Livingston et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-174 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..102L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/k2-174.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.623, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-174 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.113 dex, from Livingston et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157..102L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of K2-174 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.77269, from Dressing et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....154..207D/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 46217666333148416, flags_flame 00: age_flame 3.2574408 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 0.6256809 to 6.76099)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, K2-174: projected rotation speed 1.78 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2023A&A...676A..90R)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
